name: @bonded/mcp-server
description: Thin stdio MCP server wrapper around the real enforce() decision loop — the repo's first bin entry. Exposes one tool, bonded_verify_invoice_payment, for an agent framework to call before executing an AP/BEC-sensitive vendor payment, with zero glue code beyond `claude mcp add`. Wires the same @bonded/dispatcher composition every other caller (console, villain-corpus) uses, so this package owns no enforcement logic of its own.
